summary: Tested 3 new features (Dashboard Ventas del Día split, Historial de Cierres for superadmin vs cashier, Análisis de Producción). Backend pytest (/app/backend/tests/test_produccion_cierres_dashboard.py): 12/15 pass, 3 fail (optica 403 on /caja/cierres, IDOR on cierre detail, invalid rango date returns 500). Core features work: resumen-dia clinica+optica adds up to the total; superadmin /caja/cierres returns all cashiers (14 cierres, 3 cajeros) plus resumen_cajeros; usuario gets is_superadmin=false and only their own cierres; cierre detail sums desglose_por_metodo correctly; /ventas/analisis works for hoy/semana/mes/rango and the KPIs match tendencia, por_cajero and por_medico; usuario, optica and unauthenticated users all get 403/401. Frontend: all flows pass (card with Clínica/Óptica lines; superadmin Historial with comparativo + Cajero column + desglose detail; usuario sees no comparativo or Cajero column; nav-analisis-produccion only for superadmin; usuario going straight to /analisis-produccion is redirected; period buttons and the custom range reload the data).

critical.issue: IDOR: there is no ownership check. A non-superadmin with manage_caja (usuario) can read the detail of another cashier's cierre (Administrador General's) and gets 200. Fix: if role != superadmin and cierre.abierto_por != current_user.id, raise 403/404.

Pre-existing permission drift. config/permissions.py _MODULE_PERMS gives 'optica' manage_caja=False and manage_sales=False, but server.py _MODULE_PERMS gives True. routes/auth.require_permission (used by routes/caja.py) resolves from config/permissions.py, so optica gets 403 on /caja/cierres and /caja/estado, while /api/auth/me reports manage_caja=True. Test credentials say optica should have manage_caja.

minor.issue: Returns 500 (unhandled ValueError from dia_gt_a_rango_utc). It should return 400.
resumen_cajeros is built only from the current page (limit=30/offset), so it is not a true per-cashier summary once there are more than 30 cierres.
N+1 queries: _desglose_ingresos_dia runs once per cierre (up to 100 queries per request).

issues: The Eye/Print action buttons in the history table have no data-testid.
Days with no sales are not filled in. The line only connects days that have sales, which can make a week/month range misleading (optional: fill missing days with 0).

action_items: Add an ownership check to GET /api/caja/cierres/{cierre_id} for non-superadmin users (IDOR)
Sync the optica _MODULE_PERMS in /app/backend/config/permissions.py with server.py (manage_caja/manage_sales True). Optica currently gets 403 on /api/caja routes.
Return 400 instead of 500 for invalid dates in /api/ventas/analisis rango
Optional: compute resumen_cajeros across all cierres, not only the current page
critical_code_review_comments: Two diverging permission matrices exist (server.py vs config/permissions.py). Root cause of the optica 403.
get_cierre lacks the same scoping that get_historial_cierres applies
Unvalidated desde/hasta in analisis_produccion cause a 500
seed_data_creation: None. Only read-only requests were made.

Expected failures until fixed: test_cierres_optica_only_own, test_cierre_detalle_idor_non_superadmin, test_analisis_rango_invalido.
